test_run_action_sensitivity_analysis: test the action sensitivity analysis by running trials on llvm-v0 with specified actions and benchmarks
run_action_sensitivity_analysis: run an action sensitivity analysis with specified actions, reward space, number of trials, and warmup steps
run_sensitivity_analysis_eval: run evaluation on sensitivity analysis results using rewards and runtimes output files
review_test_run_action_sensitivity_analy: review the test function that validates action sensitivity analysis output files are created correctly
summarize_test_run_action_sensitivity_an: summarize the end-to-end test that runs action sensitivity analysis and evaluates results
